description: This file implements the backend logic for handling notification subscriptions in the focalboard server, including subscription management, event handling, and notification hint updates.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Implements notification backend for subscriptions, handling events, notifications, and subscription management.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Backend with provided parameters.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the notification backend, initializing necessary components.

methods.name: ShutDown
methods.description: Stops the notification backend and flushes logs.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the backend.

methods.name: getBlockUpdateFreq
methods.description: Determines the frequency for block update notifications, considering environment variables and default settings.

methods.name: BlockChanged
methods.description: Handles block change events, manages subscriptions, and triggers notifications for board, card, and block subscribers.

methods.name: notifySubscribers
methods.description: Triggers notification hints for subscribers related to a specific block.

methods.name: OnMention
methods.description: Handles @mention events by creating subscriptions for mentioned users if they have permission.
